name: xmind-mind-map-viewer
description: XMind viewer and mind map viewer for VS Code. Opens XMind 2020+, XMind Zen and XMind 8 files with every sheet as a tab, relationships, boundaries, summaries, markers, notes, pictures and LaTeX equations. Also opens FreeMind .mm and OPML. Search, collapse, PNG, SVG and Markdown export. Free, works offline.

enumDescriptions: The layout saved in the file
xmindViewer.defaultLayout.description: Layout of a sheet when it opens. You can change it per sheet in the toolbar.

xmindViewer.collapseLevel.description: Collapse branches below this level when a map opens. 0 shows every topic (branches folded in XMind stay folded).

xmindViewer.useMapColors.description: Use topic fill and text colors saved in the map. Turn off to draw every topic in the colors of your VS Code theme.

xmindViewer.maxFileMB.description: Files up to this size (in MB) are opened. An .xmind file is read in parts: only the map and the pictures on screen are unpacked.

xmindViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used XMind Viewer on a few files on different days. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

xmindViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the corner of the viewer. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with XMind Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Read XMind mind maps in VS Code without XMind.

steps.title: Open an XMind file
steps.description:
Click a .xmind, .mm or .opml file in the Explorer. Every sheet of the map is a tab at the top.
[Find a mind map](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.xmind%22%5D)

media.altText: An XMind 2020 map in XMind Viewer with sheet tabs, relationships, a boundary, a summary, markers and an equation.

steps.title: Move, zoom and collapse
steps.description: Drag to move the map. Ctrl or Cmd + wheel zooms at the mouse, F fits the sheet. Click the small circle at the end of a branch, or press Space, to collapse it.

steps.title: Search and export
steps.description:
Search finds topics, notes and labels, even in collapsed branches. Export saves PNG or SVG, or copies the sheet as a Markdown outline.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22xmindViewer%22%5D)
